Title: Task Priority Uses Severity-First Ordering
Content: MemorySmith task triage now uses priority as the practical severity signal. High priority is reserved for active security exposure, authorization gaps, integrity risks, and user-visible availability failures. Medium priority covers guardrails, regression matrices, migration compatibility, and maintainability refactors that reduce future risk but are not immediate exploitability/outage issues. Reprioritization examples from 2026-05-23: anti-forgery/bootstrap hardening moved to High, TaskDomainService decomposition moved to High due direct linkage with active reliability/security findings, and test fixture splitting moved to Medium.
